steps.message: 🎬 STARTING VISUAL DEMO - Watch the TestWpfApp window!
steps.description: Demo start
Clearing the main text box - you should see it empty now
Pause to let you see the cleared text box
Typing demo text - watch the text appear!
Pause to let you see the typed text
Clicking the main button - watch for button press animation
Pause after button click
Toggling checkbox - watch the checkmark appear/disappear
Pause after checkbox toggle
Selecting Item 2 from combo box - watch the selection change
Pause after combo box selection
Moving slider to 75% - watch the slider thumb move
Pause after slider movement
Switching to Tab 2 - watch the tab change
Pause on Tab 2
Switching back to Tab 1 - watch the tab change back
Final pause on Tab 1
Final clear of text box
Final message in text box

steps.message: 🎉 VISUAL DEMO COMPLETE - Check the TestWpfApp to see the final message!
steps.description: Demo completion
